desc: Establish equivalence: distinct in-degree sequences ↔ T_G(2,1) ↔ number of forests of G (confirmed on Sample 1: triangle forests 7 × bridge 2 = 14)
Derive transfer matrices: sweep rim with state c = "open component already has a chosen spoke"; transitions give M_i = [[2+s_i, s_i],[1,1]] (A for s_i=0, B for s_i=1)

Justify cyclic closure: trace counts wrap-consistent configurations; subtract exactly 2 phantom all-rim-edges cases (c≡0 gives the rim cycle itself, c≡1 claims a nonexistent spoke); verified k=0 gives 2^N−1 and K_4 (N=3, s=111) gives 38 by hand
Brute-force validate formula for all s, N ≤ 8 (all 504 cases match exhaustive orientation enumeration)
Write final program: read N, s; accumulate 2×2 product with running mod; output (a+d−2) % MOD normalized to [0,MOD); O(N) time, O(1) memory
Re-check edge cases in final code: all-zero s, all-one s, N=3 minimum, mod-negative normalization (Python % yields non-negative; right-multiplication order is safe since trace is cyclic-invariant)
